_about: Album record (Album Playbook, Nov 8): the proof for steps 1-8 that scripts/checks/album_gate.py checks and scripts/albumreview/build_review.py turns into the review page. One file per album: config/album-records/<set>.json. Paths are repo-relative. read_review.py appends to 'rounds' when her answers are applied.

items.label: Green Dragon: teal frame, gold dragon
Red Dragon: mulberry frame, gold dragon
Joker: deep green lion, mulberry stripes

picks.why: The teal-framed dragon in gold, her back colour on a face.
Its mulberry twin: her sister colour.
The signature tile: a gold-winged crane with a teal crest.
A gold peacock feather: the gold palm on her back, on the face.
The deep green lion in mulberry and gold stripes. The boldest tile in the set.

bysight.note: Every shortlisted mat looked at next to the tile photo; cut mats keep a reason in the left-out list.
bysight.catalog_new: Nov 8: all 112 new catalog mats (58 Amazon ShopMy pins, 54 partner-store mats) looked at on one sheet next to the tiles: none new in. Ocean Florals (its new 'with instructions' version) is already in as the plain mat; Amazon Emerald Green Chinoiserie is teal-green on teal, tonal. The rest are fall, game-day, pastel or red-and-green Christmas mats.

pool.repull_nov08: Re-pulled Nov 8 ~2:45pm after Tiffany caught Britt Mills Scarlett + Flora. discovery.note: Light targeted search (12 searches: Google, Etsy, Amazon via WebSearch/WebFetch). discovery.recheck_nonpartner: Rule Nov 8 2:03pm ('if it matches, it matches'): the 5 Tiles & Tablescapes Deco Lagoon pairings dropped only as non-partners (Lemondrop Garnet Blooms, Mahjong by SI Gatsby / Fall Into the Wild / Brewtifully leatherette, Golden Pond Parlor; Printerval unnamed) need their product photos to be judged; a light search did not find the listings. Next: pull the photos from the TNT posts in Chrome and judge by eye.
discovery.complementary: Complementary re-check (Tiffany 2:05pm: the colour pull leans tonal): berry/magenta/plum/coral/gold mats already carry the album's standouts (Reba, Viola, Deco Dragon Mulberry, Wren) and Garden Party Mulberry, East Meets West Magenta, Pretty in Plum; Delilah stays out (bright turquoise, not her deep teal).
